Baato leans in and studies the rusted face of the March Start Marker. The wind howls through the hollow post, but his eyes catch a shallow groove cut into the metal near the base—a clean, deliberate line that angles slightly upward. It’s a mason’s alignment mark, faded but unmistakable.

QA Lantern Witness watches him from a few paces away, her expression neutral. She doesn’t speak, just notes the moment in her mind.

QA Cinder Witness tilts her head, curiosity flickering. “You see something?” she asks, stepping closer. “That thing’s been here forever. Probably just scrap.”
